description: Three chains that delay a polyphonic signal by whole samples, for lining one signal path up with another

inputs.text: The signal that chain delays, polyphonic

outputs.text: That chain's input delayed by one sample
That chain's input delayed by two samples

notes: a chain whose input is unpatched carries on from the chain above it, so leaving the second and third inputs empty gives up to six samples of delay from the first input
